atoms.text: Avari was the most famous inventor in Octaviough, a country far away behind the great oceans of Grandoceen. He was well known all over the country for inventing hundreds of things to help his friends. He had heard stories about powerful materials that could only be found on the two islands in the south-west sea, but he would have to cross the dangerous, choppy sea to get there.

atoms.text: The best sailors in the land had been training for years to be able to cross this dangerous river; they lived in the city of Bravio. Avari had to travel for many days to get to Bravio, through a heavy storm and over the mountains. When he finally arrived, the city was like a ghost town. Normally it was busy and loud, but today Avari could hear a pin drop. Avari knocked on the door of the inn and found out an even bigger storm was coming, so everyone had locked themselves away in fear.

atoms.sound: Avari was devastated, but wasn’t out of ideas yet. 'What if I can invent a machine that can swim underwater', thought Avari, 'then the sailors could avoid the crashing waves and swim underneath them!' He hurried home, excited by his new project.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: He worked tirelessly day and night until it was finished. A week later, he made the long journey back to Bravio to show the sailors his new creation. They tested Avari’s machine by taking him to the islands in the south-west sea - just as he had desired. They were thrilled and promised to provide Avari with a lifetime supply of fish as a sign of their gratitude.
